The '''oevvaor''' was a predatory marine reptile that lived on the shores of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The [[Gender/Legends|males]] of the species possessed an [[Axe/Legends|axe]]-like horn on their heads. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] named one of their military vehicles, the [[Oevvaor jet catamaran/Legends|Oevvaor jet catamaran]], after this beast.
